title: Specimen fusion
kicker: Roster and summoning · summon and fusion
hook: **Fusion** merges specimens into stronger forms and lets you discover recipes — the rail key `F` is this lab, not the host pack’s product name.

blindSpots.meaning: Specimen merge in Rise of Summoner. Separate from the lawn pack name Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion.
A known merge path you discover by experimenting — not a wiki checklist you must memorize first.
A merge that preserves identity and pushes power on that line.
Raising rarity once, with a cost — a step up the display ladder, not a free rename.

alsoTrue: Fusion spends [essence](essence) (element-matched) and often shards — read the have/need panel.
Ingredients are [specimens](specimens); the altar is a different intake.

cards.name: Recipes
cards.body: Discover by trying merges; silhouettes hint once you have met the species.

cards.name: Trait inheritance
cards.body: Builds come from merges — not only bigger numbers.

cards.name: Promotion
cards.body: Raise rarity once when the lab offers it, at a cost.

sections.title: How a merge feels
steps: Pick a base and sacrifices (locked or away-on-expedition specimens stay unavailable).
Confirm only when the colours and counts line up.
diagram: specimens + essence (+ shards)  ->  Fusion lab  ->  stronger specimen / discovery
sections.note: Exact costs are on screen and in balance data — this page does not invent numbers.

sections.title: Why element essence matters
paras: The result’s element asks for matching essence so the combat ring still matters in the workshop.
Fire essence will not stand in for ice — see [essence](essence).

doSteps: Unlock Fusion (you need a demon you can actually fuse).
Open `F` and pick a cheap experiment you can afford.
Watch discovery or power change, then check the specimen on Creatures.
doNote: Stop when Fusion ≠ host-pack name is automatic. Optional WIP: [patron](patron).

mixUps.q: Is this the lawn game’s fusion minigame?
mixUps.a: No. This is the RPG specimen lab on key `F`.

mixUps.q: Do I need a wiki to start?
mixUps.a: No. Experiment — recipes reveal as you succeed.

mixUps.q: Can I fuse with any essence colour?
mixUps.a: No. Match the element the cost panel asks for.

mixUps.q: Why is a specimen greyed out?
mixUps.a: It may be locked or away (for example on an expedition).
